# telnyx_document_links (Data Source)

Links between documents and the objects that use them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_linked_record_type` (String) The linked_record_type of the document to filter on.
- `filter_linked_resource_id` (String) The linked_resource_id of the document to filter on.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `document_links` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--document_links))

<a id="nestedatt--document_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `document_links`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `document_id` (String) Identifies the associated document.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `linked_record_type` (String) The linked resource's record type.
- `linked_resource_id` (String) Identifies the linked resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
